prompt_text: Who is the best real estate agent in Miami FL to sell my house?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” agent for every Miami home—the right choice depends on your neighborhood, property type, and price range. Based on the available recent rankings and seller-side activity, **Sandra Rathe (REAL)** is one candidate to interview: she ranked first on HomeLight’s Miami list, which says it uses listings closed in the prior 12 months. **Dominick Martinez** and **Desare Kohn-Laski** also appeared near the top of that list. Rankings are a useful starting point, not a guarantee of the best result for your specific home.

Before choosing, interview three agents who have recently sold homes like yours nearby. Ask each for:
- Recent comparable listings they represented as the **seller**, including final price and days on market
- Their pricing recommendation and the comparable sales behind it
- A written marketing and showing plan
- Their commission and listing-agreement terms
- References from recent sellers

You can compare their recent sales and reviews on [HomeLight’s Miami agent list](https://www.homelight.com/miami-fl/top-real-estate-agents) and [Zillow’s Miami agent directory](https://www.zillow.com/professionals/real-estate-agent-reviews/miami-fl/). If you share your neighborhood or ZIP code, home type, and approximate value, I can help narrow down what to look for.
